//: Second compile, dedicated to the serverless function in api/.
The main tsconfig emits dist/ for `npm start` and the worker. The function
needs the same code, but importing across into the gitignored dist/ is
exactly what made Vercel fail at runtime with:
Everything inside api/ ships with the function by definition, so this emits
src/ to api/lib/ and api/index.js imports ./lib/app.js - a relative path
that can never point outside the bundle.
